limitations: Fresh execution after the unavailable prior attempt. Shared host and instructional isolation, cache/acquisition timing and unavailable resolved identities/native usage limit comparisons. The main visual review distinguishes pre-final final-04 observations from final-05 return-surface views and a continuation. Controlled Chromium operations and viewed frames do not establish physical mobile keyboard/IME, other engines, screen-reader experience, natural-time playback or human acceptance. The source-family build advisory and broader inherited English navigation remain.
